tools.name: site-search
tools.description: Search the Safeguard Global website using the site search and return a concise list of matching results (numbered title, URL, and short description). Use this tool to find pages, resources, case studies, solutions, countries and events on safeguardglobal.com. Returns up to 10 unique results per page. Pass the optional page parameter to request a later page (1-based).

search-query.description: The terms to search for on the Safeguard Global website.

page.description: Results page number, starting at 1 (the first page). 10 results per page. Leave empty for the first page.
